---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an addition or change to panelist
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do, and where does panelist currently fall short?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see added or changed. If this touches persona identity or
scoring, note how it fits the behavioral (not demographic) model — see
[`docs/synthetic-persona-best-practices.md`](../../docs/synthetic-persona-best-practices.md).

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you've thought about, and why you didn't propose them.

## Scope check

- [ ] This belongs in `src/` (core library behavior), not a consumer repo
- [ ] This isn't better served by a persona pack (`packs/`) or a
      consumer-side extension

## Additional context

Anything else relevant — links, examples from other tools, related issues.
